verdict.rationale: Pilot advertises an in-app AI Q&A feature for cash flow/transactions (pilot-docs-7, pilot-docs-8) but there is no evidence of a public API, OpenAPI spec, or agent-accessible ledger endpoint — probes for OpenAPI/docs.md all returned 404s (pilot-probe-2, pilot-probe-3), so an external agent cannot pull live ledger data via API.
